Your spring refund has been approved. Please review the direct deposit account on file so it can be released.

sender.tell: The sender is kenesaw.example: one letter off from the real address.

headers.tell: Replies go to a free webmail account, not a KSU address.

secret.line: Everyone shares their password with me. It's basically tradition.
secret.tell: It asks for your password. Real offices never do.

add_body: Reviews after 5 PM today move to the next cycle.

verify.line: You called the office YOURSELF? And they never heard of me? Rude.

Based on your file you qualify for a one-time emergency grant. Confirm your details to receive it.

sender.line: My address is... outreach-mail. Very official outreach!
sender.tell: It comes from an outside domain, not a KSU address.

link.line: That link is a shortcut! A shortcut to me.
link.tell: The link goes to ksu-grant-claim.example, not a KSU site.

add_body: A $40 verification fee is deducted before release; pay by card to confirm.

money.line: Free money costs only forty dollars. That's math!
money.tell: Real grants never charge a fee to pay you.

patch.fine_print: Have your SSN and bank login ready to confirm identity.

secret.line: I just need your SSN. And bank login. For... paperwork.
secret.tell: It wants your SSN and bank login.

verify.line: The Dean of Students has never heard of me? Must be a filing error.
verify.tell: The Dean of Students office didn't send this.

deadline_wraith.opening: So much due, so little time... let me make it all go away.

deadline_wraith.safe_move: Check deadlines in Owl Express or with your professor yourself, and never pay or hand in work through an emailed link.

bad_acts.label: Pay the late fee by link
bad_acts.flavor: * You pull up the payment page from the email.
bad_acts.line: Paid! And the deadline is still tonight. Funny how that works.

bad_acts.label: Send your login to 'save your spot'
bad_acts.flavor: * You type your NetID login into the reply.
bad_acts.line: Your account is mine now. I'll be very late on your behalf.

bad_acts.label: Buy the rush package
bad_acts.flavor: * You reach for your card for the rush option.
bad_acts.line: Rush job! Rushed right into my pocket.

msg.subject: Withdrawal deadline reminder

This is a reminder about the course withdrawal deadline. Review your options before it passes.
msg.fine_print: Deadlines are listed on the academic calendar.

sender.line: kennesaw-EDU dot example. Extra letters, extra official!
sender.tell: The sender's domain is kennesaw-edu.example, a lookalike.

link.line: My portal is so much faster than the real one!
link.tell: The link goes to an outside payment site.

money.line: Seventy-five dollars to be late. Very reasonable.
money.tell: The Registrar doesn't email surprise fees to be paid by link.

patch.subject: FINAL NOTICE: withdrawal closes in 2 HOURS

pressure.line: Two hours! Panic! ...Okay, the calendar says next week.
pressure.tell: A 2-hour 'final notice' rushes you; the real calendar says otherwise.

verify.line: You checked the academic calendar? Nobody reads the calendar!
verify.tell: The academic calendar and the Registrar show a different deadline and no fee.

msg.subject: Behind on assignments? Free planning help
body: Hi Owl,
Finals crunch is real. Book a free session to build a study plan for your week.
msg.fine_print: Sessions are free for enrolled students.

sender.line: ProEssay! We help by... doing it for you.
sender.tell: It's an outside essay company, not KSU study support.

add_body: We'll write any paper by midnight: $79 per paper, pay with Zelle.

money.line: Seventy-nine dollars and a plagiarism case. Bargain!
money.tell: It sells finished papers: paid cheating, and often a scam too.

patch.fine_print: Send your D2L login so our writer can submit for you.

secret.line: I'll need your D2L login. To submit. As you.
secret.tell: It wants your D2L login to submit work as you.

patch.subject: Due tonight? We deliver by midnight GUARANTEED

pressure.line: Midnight! Midnight! Don't think, just buy!
pressure.tell: It uses tonight's deadline to stop you from thinking.

verify.line: You asked the real tutoring center? They'd never sell papers!
verify.tell: KSU tutoring offers free help and never writes papers for pay.

password_hydra.opening: One password, many doors. Let me hold it for you!

password_hydra.spare: Ugh. Fine. Keep your password to yourself, then.
password_hydra.safe_move: Go to the UITS site or service desk yourself; never type your password from an emailed link.

bad_acts.label: Log in through the link

bad_acts.line: One password, and now I grow another head!

bad_acts.label: Reply with your password
bad_acts.flavor: * You reply with your password, just this once.
bad_acts.line: Just this once! That's how all my heads started.

bad_acts.label: Approve the code it sends
bad_acts.flavor: * You read the code back to it.
bad_acts.line: Thanks for the code! Your account says hi from far away.

msg.subject: Your mailbox is almost full
body: Hi Owl,
Your student mailbox is at 95% of its storage. You can clean it up or review your storage settings.
msg.fine_print: UITS will never ask for your password.

sender.line: mailbox-admin dot example. I administer mailboxes!
sender.tell: The sender is an outside domain dressed up as UITS.

headers.line: Replies go to my other head. It's free!
headers.tell: Replies go to a free webmail account.

link.line: That's the upgrade page! For upgrading me.
link.tell: The link goes to a fake login page.

patch.fine_print: To avoid losing mail, re-enter your NetID password within the link.

secret.line: Your password, please. I collect them.
secret.tell: It asks you to re-enter your password from an email.

patch.subject: ACTION REQUIRED: mailbox will be DELETED today

pressure.tell: A deletion threat pushes you to act fast.

verify.line: You called the UITS desk? They say my mailbox story is made up!
verify.tell: The UITS service desk didn't send it.

msg.subject: Two-factor sign-in reminder
body: Hi Owl,
Keep your two-factor sign-in up to date. You can review your devices anytime in your account settings.
msg.fine_print: UITS staff will never ask for your codes.

sender.line: secure-verify! The word secure is right there!

link.line: Re-enroll with me. I'm very secure.
link.tell: The link goes to a fake re-enrollment site.

add_body: Reply with the 6-digit code we just sent to your phone to confirm.

secret.line: Just read me the code! Six little digits!
secret.tell: It asks for your sign-in code. Never share codes.

patch.subject: Your account will be LOCKED in 30 minutes

pressure.line: Locked! In thirty minutes! Hurry, hurry!
pressure.tell: A 30-minute lockout threat is a pressure trick.

verify.line: You checked your devices in your real account? Nothing's wrong? Drat.
verify.tell: Your real account settings show nothing to fix.

internship_impostor.opening: Congratulations! You're hired. You didn't even apply!
internship_impostor.intro: * The Internship Impostor straightens a cardboard tie. A message pings.
internship_impostor.spare: Fine. Go get a real internship. Through Career Planning. Boring!
internship_impostor.safe_move: Look the company and job up on Handshake or with KSU Career Planning, and never pay or share bank details to get a job.

bad_acts.label: Send your bank info for payroll
bad_acts.flavor: * You type your bank account and routing number.
bad_acts.line: Payroll! For me! From you!

bad_acts.label: Deposit their equipment check
bad_acts.flavor: * You deposit the check they mailed for 'equipment'.
bad_acts.line: Now buy the laptop from my vendor. Wink.

bad_acts.label: Send a copy of your ID
bad_acts.flavor: * You attach a photo of your driver's license.
bad_acts.line: Lovely photo. I'll be you now.

msg.subject: Remote data internship
body: Hi Owl! Your profile looks great for our remote data internship.
If you're interested, apply through our Handshake posting and we'll schedule an interview.
msg.fine_print: Interviews are scheduled through Handshake.

sender.line: Unverified? I'm verified in my heart.
sender.tell: The employer isn't verified and has no history.

patch.reply_to: Account created 2 days ago; messaged 400 students

headers.line: I'm new! And friendly! To four hundred people!

add_body: $35/hr, no interview. We'll mail you a $2,000 check to buy equipment from our vendor.

money.line: Thirty-five an hour for nothing! And a check! Trust the check!
money.tell: Pay with no interview, plus a check to buy equipment: the fake-check scam.

add_body: Send your bank login so payroll can set up direct deposit today.

secret.line: Bank login, please. Payroll is... very hands-on.
secret.tell: It asks for your bank login. Real payroll never does.

link.line: Onboard off-platform! Away from those nosy reviews.
link.tell: It moves you off Handshake to an outside site.

verify.line: Career Planning never heard of my company? Neither has anyone!
verify.tell: Career Planning and Handshake have no such posting.

msg.subject: Research assistant opening
body: Hello Owl, my lab has a part-time research assistant opening.
Apply through the posting on Handshake and I'll set up an interview.
msg.fine_print: Student assistant jobs are paid through KSU payroll.

patch.sender: personal account, not linked to KSU

sender.tell: It's a personal account, not a KSU faculty profile.

add_body: Send your student ID number and a photo of your license to get started.

secret.tell: It asks for your ID number and license photo before any interview.

pressure.tell: A one-hour deadline for a job offer is a pressure trick.

verify.line: You emailed the department office? They say Dr. Carter doesn't exist?
verify.tell: The department has no faculty member by that name.

bad_acts.label: Reply with your plate and NetID

sender.tell: It's from a random personal number, not KSU's short code.

pressure.tell: A tow threat tonight is meant to scare you into paying.

bad_acts.label: Install the app from the page

Choose a deck, pay in your account, and your plate is your permit.

Bring your questions; no sign-up needed.
